group.div: Private text only. Authorize consenting test recipients explicitly. This does not register a webhook, enable a scheduler, grant message consent or approve a reply.

button.name: action_authorize_telegram_sandbox
button.confirm: Verify this bot and authorize sandbox processing for the displayed recipient IDs and evidence? Each reply still requires current consent and separate approval.

button.name: action_revoke_telegram_sandbox
button.confirm: Stop sandbox intake and future send claims? Existing in-flight sends may still complete; unclaimed work will require fresh approval.

button.name: action_enable_telegram_dispatch
button.confirm: Enable new dispatch claims for human-approved private replies to this bot's authorized sandbox recipients? The scheduler is configured separately. This does not send a message now.

xpath.p: Telegram sandbox replies require explicit account authorization, a verified private conversation, current recipient consent and separate message approval. Pausing stops new claims; in-flight sends may finish.
Provider dispatch requires a verified adapter and explicit activation. Pausing stops new claims; in-flight sends may finish.
